ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a contour topographic map, and contour elevation labels such as 50 and 150 can be seen, indicating that the height difference between adjacent contour lines is 50 meters. The cliff position is shown as multiple contour lines overlapping or intersecting at the same place, and 4 contour lines can be counted passing through the cliff in the figure. Then reason: The minimum value of the relative height of a cliff is calculated by the formula (number of contour lines passing through the cliff - 1) × contour interval, that is, (4-1)×50=150 meters. Therefore, the minimum height difference of the cliff in the figure may be 150 meters.
